items.title: Warhammer 40,000: Dawn of War 4 gets a model painter demo, so you can make a mess of your Orks, Necrons, Space Marines and AdMech before they even hit the battlefield
items.en_title: Warhammer 40,000: Dawn of War 4 gets a model painter demo, so you can make a mess of your Orks, Necrons, Space Marines and AdMech before they even hit the battlefield
items.en_oneliner: A week before launch, King Art released a standalone model painter demo so players can try out paint schemes on Orks, Necrons, Space Marines and Adeptus Mechanicus units before they hit the battlefield.

Team Cherry Uses The Pull Of Silksong To Highlight A Trio Of Wonderful-Looking Indies
items.en_title: Team Cherry Uses The Pull Of Silksong To Highlight A Trio Of Wonderful-Looking Indies
items.en_oneliner: Team Cherry is using the spotlight from Silksong to highlight three promising-looking indie games from Australia, giving fellow developers a genuine visibility boost.
